rules.rule: Every fenced json or yaml code block in a markdown file must carry a tag in the fence info string from the set documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. Flag any block with no tag or a tag outside the set. For blocks tagged mirrord, mirrord=<path>, mirrord-up or mirrord-up=<path>: flag the block if it is not valid JSON or YAML (placeholders like ..., inline comments, trailing commas), for a mirrord=<path> fragment flag it if <path> does not exist in skills/mirrord-config/references/schema.json or the block's top-level keys are not properties of the object at that path, and for a mirrord-up=<path> fragment flag it if <path> does not exist in skills/mirrord-up/references/schema.json or the block's top-level keys are not properties of the object at that path. Skip skills/mirrord-config/references/configuration.md, skills/mirrord-config/references/schema.json, skills/mirrord-operator/references/values.yaml and skills/mirrord-up/references/schema.json, they are synced verbatim from upstream.
